name: Teresa von Ambrose
source:
A spriteless extra character in the otome game, "Eternal Blessing of the Stars"... and a former otoge-loving office lady who died in a truck-related accident.

She was reborn as a noble lady with riches and prestige... but she'd rather have her otome games rather than become a prim and proper lady who has to conform with the world's rules, giving her notoriety among the noble society as 'the thorn among flowers'.

"Otoges were the only things keeping me on leash in my past life."

[From [url=https://ant-san.itch.io/villainotome]itch.io[/url]]
